lines: Fever, chills, right flank pain, and nausea for the past 24 hours

She notes that the pain began in her lower back and gradually migrated upward.

She has also experienced urinary urgency and dysuria for several days, but thought it was "just part of pregnancy." Her prenatal course has been uncomplicated so far, denies prior UTIs during this pregnancy.
